glosses: Qui subit une tension (arc, élastique, ressort, etc.).

examples.text: L’élastique est tendu.

glosses: Qui exerce un effort en parlant des muscles, du corps.

examples.text: Le buste tendu comme un arc, les reins cambrés, la jambe allongée et levée en arrière.
La mamelle du sein est tendue.

glosses: Qui subit une tension intellectuelle, concentré, attentif, intense, en parlant de l’esprit, d’une personnalité, etc.

examples.text: Esprit, volonté tendu(e) à se rompre.
Un visage tendu.

glosses: Qui subit une tension nerveuse, angoissé, anxieux, énervé, soucieux, nerveux.

examples.text: Il est préoccupé, tendu, irritable.

glosses: Qui marque un tempérament tourmenté, un état d’énervement.

examples.text: La situation est tendue entre eux, ils passent leur temps à se disputer.
Le style de sa poésie est tendu, nerveux, incisif.

Dans les années 2000, les relations entre Harrods et la famille royale étaient pourtant tendues, en raison du rachat du groupe par Mohamed Al-Fayed, père de Dodi Al-Fayed, dernier compagnon de Lady Diana.

C’est l’un des paradoxes de l’époque : on se plaint des interviews consensuelles et aseptisées, mais dès qu’un échange est un peu tendu, il est considéré comme un clash, dès qu’une parole surnage, ça devient l’engueulade du siècle.
C'est 25 mètres sous l'eau et il fait noir. Même pour les experts, c'est tendu.

glosses: The property of indicating the point in time at which an action or state of being occurs or exists.

examples.text: Dyirbal verbs are not inflected for tense.

glosses: An inflected form of a verb that indicates tense.

examples.text: English only has a past tense and a non-past tense; it has no future tense.

glosses: A verb form or construction indicating a combination of tense, aspect, and mood.

examples.text: The "simple present" tense in English can have several meanings.
The Spanish teacher told the student to use the imperfect tense instead of the preterite tense.
tensing a verb

glosses: Showing signs of stress or strain; not relaxed.

examples.text: You need to relax, all this overtime and stress is making you tense.

"Attention," the tense man called out in Greek. "This is Lieutenant Kazamakis of the Cypriot Provisional Guard. You will immediately surrender all weapons and slowly come down the stairs, hands above your head." No answer.
"There's no one in the house," Sahas cut him off quickly. "Actually[,] I have sent them away. I thought that only the two of us should share the special surprise." He gave a tense smile.

glosses: Characterized by strain (on the nerves, emotions, etc). (Compare charged.)

examples.text: Chi stops, but her eyes continue to pierce right through me and into Karima. A tense moment later, she drops her eyes back to the terminal and scans the data once more. The showdown is over, at least for the moment.

glosses: Produced with relative constriction of the vocal tract.

examples.text: The driver and the man shouted angrily at each other and I tensed, ready for violence. But soon everyone in the tap-tap joined in, capping remarks, joking, telling chicken and goat stories.
